_tuning_notes: The memory model behind dialogue. Every typed event lands in a per-player per-faction ledger with a timestamp; disposition = sum of decayed event weights + standing * standing_baseline_factor. Decay is exponential with per-event half-lives in IN-GAME DAYS (24000 ticks): violence decays slowly, kindness faster. Bands gate which dialogue options appear and which response flavor is used. betrayal_multiplier scales negative events recorded while the player is warm-or-better (the generous-then-violent cliff). relations_echo_factor: fraction of a positive event's weight leaked as a NEGATIVE echo event to every faction hostile to the recipient. contract_target_weight: the direct hit applied to the faction an eliminate contract targeted. prune_below_abs: ledger entries whose decayed weight falls under this are deleted.
